name: Houkago Ecchi Time ~Yuu to Mio, Midara ni Modae Ochiteiku...~
original_name: 放課後えっちタイム 〜憂と澪、淫らに悶え堕ちていく…〜
source:
Yui holds a grudge against her little sister who has taken her place in the band. Then, Yui's body starts to change and she now has something in her groin.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ057060.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
